title: Glazing Team Scheduling Software | Plan Fitters and Surveyors | Coglass
description: Schedule your glazing team with a visual planning board. Assign jobs to fitters, manage absences and vehicle allocation — all synced to the mobile app instantly.
lead: Drag jobs onto your team and vehicles on a visual board, track licences and holidays, and customers get an automatic “on the way”. Everyone knows where they're meant to be — without ten phone calls.
steps_h2: Your whole team's week, planned in minutes
steps_sub: The Coglass planning board gives managers a full view of who is doing what, when — and pushes the schedule straight to everyone's phones.
inc_h2: Team management tools built for glazing companies
inc_sub: From scheduling fitters to tracking holidays — everything you need to manage a field team.
steps: The scheduling view shows your full team in rows and upcoming dates in columns. At a glance you can see who's free, who's booked, and which days have gaps — for the week or the next two weeks.

Drag an order onto a team member's slot for a specific date. Set the visit type (survey, fitting, delivery), start time and duration. The assignment appears in that person's mobile app immediately — no call needed.
Put a van with each team member for each day from the same board.
Record holidays, sick days and training in the absence calendar. Absent team members show as blocked on the planning board — you can't accidentally book them in on a day they're off.
Team see their schedule on their phone
Bookings show in the field team's app — customer, address, visit type and time — without a call from the office.

The employees section tracks staff details, roles, certifications, and mobile app access. Monitor seat usage, manage who has access to which parts of the system, and view each person's upcoming schedule at a glance.
included: Visual planning board
Drag-and-drop schedule with all staff in one view. See the full week or two-week outlook at a glance.
Job assignment with time slots
Assign any order to any team member with specific start time and duration — survey, fitting or delivery.
On their phone
Bookings show in the team member's app, with a push notification when today's plan changes.
Vehicle allocation
Assign a vehicle to each team member per day from the planning board.
Holiday and absence management
Record holidays, sick days and training. Absences block the planner so you can't double-book unavailable staff.
Holiday chart
Visual overview of all staff absences for the coming weeks — plan your resourcing before gaps appear.
Employee management
Store staff details, roles, employee types, contact info and mobile app access in one place.
Employee credentials
Track driving licences, CSCS cards, accreditations and other certifications per team member.
Roles and permissions
Control who can see and do what. Starts with owner, office manager, estimator, surveyor, fitter and shop-floor roles, each adjustable.
Nearby jobs
After you book someone, Coglass suggests other ready jobs close to their route that day.
Assignment notes
Add notes to any slot — special access instructions, customer preferences, equipment needed.
Seat licence management
See desktop and mobile user counts versus your plan limits — manage who has access without overpaying.
cta_h2: Stop coordinating your team over WhatsApp
cta_p: Book a demo and we'll walk you through it on the kind of jobs you do — or pick a plan and start a 14-day trial.
